data.headline: Director of Workforce Engineering
data.about: Technology and operations executive with 20+ years leading large-scale organizational transformation, enterprise IT strategy, and workforce productivity across global and mid-sized environments. I currently lead a 100+ person organization at Netflix, delivering the workplace technology, employee experience, and reliability platforms that support 15,000 employees globally. My focus is on building these as strategic, AI-enabled functions that help people do their best work. Prior to Netflix, I served as VP of Technology Operations at KinderCare, where I led engineering, IT Services, and Information Security & Compliance teams supporting frontline employees and the families they serve. That experience shaped my approach to building organizations that are not only high-performing, but closely connected to the people and communities they serve. I am most drawn to technology leadership roles where the work has direct, tangible impact on the people and communities the organization serves.

description.text:
★ When I stepped into this role, my charter was to help make technology at Netflix work for employees, not the other way around. Over time, that opportunity grew into leading multiple engineering domains spanning Collaboration & Communication, Endpoint Management, Productivity & GenAI, Engineering Operations, Site Reliability Engineering, Customer Support Platforms, and Talent Tech, all touching the daily experience of 15,000 employees around the world.
★ I’ve had the privilege of partnering closely with our Product, Security, and Support teams to build and evolve internal platforms that are not only secure and reliable but also delightful to use. From Google Workspace and Slack to Zendesk, Atlassian, and custom-built GenAI tools, my teams have focused on simplifying complexity, reducing friction, and empowering people to do their best work.
★ A big part of my journey has been transforming our engineering culture, creating an environment rooted in trust, transparency, and continuous learning. Over time, we have seen morale and innovation soar, engagement surge, and inclusion and talent density be a strength we actively leverage. It's an honor to support the leaders and engineers who made that possible.
★ Scaling the organization, I built new teams from the ground up, defining their charters, hiring exceptional talent, and helping them mature into high-performing, reliable, and resilient groups. 
★ One of these new teams is the NTech SRE teams. Learn more here: https://tinyurl.com/NTSRE
★ One of the most rewarding highlights has been supporting the teams that have launched GenAI-powered productivity solutions that reimagined how employees access knowledge.

The organization covers Software, Systems, and Client Engineering, along with Engineering Operations, Site Reliability, Business Systems, Customer Service, and Talent Tech.

subComponents.title: Sr. Director of Workforce Engineering & Technology
subComponents.caption: Feb 2023 - Oct 2023 · 8 mos

description.text:
★ When I joined Epic Games, I set out to bring clarity, connection, and purpose to how we supported our global workforce through technology. I unified end-user engineering, tech support, and operations into a single, cohesive Workforce Engineering & Technology organization, one that could deliver at scale while staying people-focused and outcome-driven.
★ After being promoted to lead Global IT Support and Business Operations, I guided a 120+ person global team of full-time and contingent staff dedicated to empowering Epic employees through scalable systems, reliable services, and great support experiences.
★ To sharpen our focus, I introduced a strategic framework called “Back to Basics”, built around three pillars: Enable the Business, Sustain Critical Services, and Operationalize & Improve. This model helped streamline planning, clarify ownership, and align stakeholders on shared priorities, turning a scattered effort into a unified vision.
★ Within my first 90 days, I helped transform the IT Support organization by defining a clear mission and leadership expectations, setting measurable performance goals, and reigniting trust and engagement across teams that had been craving direction and purpose.
★ Beyond operations, I invested deeply in leadership development, coaching seven senior leaders through personalized growth plans, ongoing feedback, and stretch opportunities that strengthened both their confidence and the organization’s succession pipeline.
★ I also built core enterprise programs like IT Asset Management, Vendor Management, and SaaS cost rationalization to drive financial accountability and operational maturity.
★ I was honored to be selected to serve on the Women’s ERG Council, where I helped advance DEI initiatives across Epic Games and amplified representation and engagement across our global workforce.

★ In this role, I led a talented team of senior leaders and more than 20 engineers and specialists, all focused on one shared mission: to make technology at Epic Games seamless, secure, and empowering for our global creative, art, and engineering communities.
★ I guided the End User Engineering organization, bringing together our Client Platform, Software, and Cloud Apps teams to deliver high-performance, innovative solutions that kept employees connected and productive. A big part of my work was aligning technical roadmaps with business goals, balancing the quick wins that solved today’s challenges with the longer-term strategies that future-proofed our workforce productivity.
★ I also oversaw and optimized a complex SaaS portfolio, including Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, and the Atlassian Suite, ensuring reliability, cost efficiency, and effortless collaboration across teams.
★ One of the most impactful initiatives I led was modernizing our client platform infrastructure by introducing FleetMDM, NanoMDM, and Puppet, enabling infrastructure-as-code practices that significantly improved manageability, security, and scalability.
★ Collaboration was at the heart of everything I did. By building strong partnerships with InfoSec and M&A teams, I helped ensure our initiatives were aligned, coordinated, and executed with transparency, turning technology delivery into a true cross-functional success story.

★ In this role, I had the opportunity to lead two incredible centralized engineering teams focused on one mission, making work at Netflix simpler, smarter, and more seamless. We tackled everything from eliminating workflow friction and driving automation to strengthening the shared infrastructure that supports thousands of employees every day.
★ A big part of my work centered around building strong partnerships across the business, listening, identifying unmet needs, and expanding our team’s capabilities to deliver solutions that truly moved the needle on productivity and alignment.
★ I oversaw a broad portfolio of enterprise systems, including Active Directory, Google Workspace, Slack, Zendesk, and ServiceNow, ensuring they operated reliably, scaled efficiently, and integrated smoothly into Netflix’s ecosystem. Along the way, my teams delivered custom engineering solutions that automated tedious manual tasks, streamlined processes, and reduced operational overhead across the company.
★ Equally important to me was investing in people. I had the privilege of mentoring and coaching talented engineers, new grads, and leaders, helping them grow technically, develop their leadership skills, and navigate their career paths. Together, we built a culture grounded in accountability, learning, and inclusion.
★ I also championed hiring and retention initiatives that brought in exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds, strengthening representation and fostering a sense of belonging within the organization.

★ I had the opportunity to shape and scale multiple technology organizations, from Technical Services and Application Development to Endpoint Engineering, Information Security, and Compliance. I focused on creating technology strategies and roadmaps that not only improved reliability and security but also made a real difference in how employees worked.
★ In my time at KinderCare, I was promoted from Sr. Director, IT Service Management, to Sr. Director, Tech Services & Information Security, to VP of Technology Operations, where I drove enterprise-wide operational excellence and modernized core IT services. 
★ One of my proudest achievements was transitioning IT service management in-house, ahead of schedule and under budget, while building a Portland-based team that went on to earn industry-leading service quality scores and become the #1 “field excitement driver” in company-wide surveys.
★ When the pandemic hit, my teams pivoted fast, deploying VoIP, WebEx, and Slack (with SSO) to enable remote work for over 1,000 employees, while keeping service quality above 95%. We also delivered large-scale infrastructure programs: 10,000+ iPad deployments, full laptop fleet refreshes, and SD-WAN upgrades that cut downtime and costs while improving user experience.
★ Under my leadership, we achieved 100% PCI DSS compliance for two consecutive years by rolling out enterprise MFA, migrating to Splunk SIEM, and running targeted penetration testing that uncovered and remediated critical vulnerabilities. To keep our teams efficient and aligned, I introduced agile delivery methods like Kanban and Scrum.
★ Over the years, I built and led high-performing teams of 150+ professionals. Mentoring and growing great talent has always been one of the most rewarding parts of my work, and I’m proud to have seen so many team members advance into leadership roles.

subComponents.title: Director of IT Applications & Data Services, Web Operations
subComponents.caption: Nov 2017 - Dec 2018 · 1 yr 1 mo

description.text:
★ When I stepped into this role, my goal was to bring clarity, accountability, and a stronger sense of purpose to how our teams worked together. I introduced Kanban practices within Web Operations, which helped improve workflow visibility, streamline delivery, and make our engineering commitments more predictable and reliable for internal customers.
★ After being promoted from Senior Manager to Director, I took on leadership of Web Operations, Data & Analytics, and Application Development, overseeing teams across global locations and ensuring our technology efforts were tightly aligned with business priorities.
★ One of the transformations I’m most proud of was evolving the Data & Analytics team from a group of operational administrators into true Service and Product Owners. That shift increased engagement, retention, and adoption of analytics products across the organization, turning data into a more strategic, accessible asset.
★ Beyond the technical side, I also helped design and launch several Diversity & Inclusion initiatives, including an IT cohort program focused on building community, fostering inclusive norms, and strengthening engagement across teams.
